textTemplates.name: BodyProductionSupportCase
ExternalEmailBody
textTemplates.text:
Thank you for contacting Team Velocity support. We have received your request and have opened a ticket for our support team to review. Please save this case number for your records. A member of the team will be reaching out with updates as your request is reviewed and completed.


If your request is time-sensitive, please call us at 703-661-3350 and press option 3. Or reach out to your account team which can be located by clicking the “?” in the upper right corner of Apollo.

Thank you!
Team Velocity Support

textTemplates.name: ExternalEmailBody_Holiday
textTemplates.text:
Thank you for contacting Team Velocity Support.


Our offices are currently operating on a modified schedule in observance of the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.


Thanksgiving Day Support – Thursday, November 27th

Our offices will be closed. For emergency support only, please:

  • Email: support@teamvelocitymarketing.com and we will work on your request once our offices open again.
  • Contact your account team directly for escalation.

Black Friday Support – Friday, November 28th

We will be observing our Saturday support hours.

Our support team will be available from 9:00am – 6:00pm ET.

Please send all requests to support@teamvelocitymarketing.com and any escalations to your account team directly.


We appreciate your patience and will respond to your request as soon as possible during our holiday support hours.


Happy Thanksgiving!
